name: 洪荒世界
english_description: A member of the NT/nitan/Lonely engine family -- confirmed byte-identical master.c/dbase.c against nitan170911 (Chinese Paladin), which shares this lineage with nitan6 (Laughing in the Wind) in this project -- reskinned around Investiture of the Gods mythology and Pangu's separation of heaven and earth. New characters open on the creation of the world itself: meet Pangu in the Valley of Life, choose a character personality and race, then pass through the Court of Hell for a genuine reincarnation ceremony -- more ritual than the plain gender-then-go pattern common elsewhere in this collection. The full birth sequence runs zz <number> (race) -> xuan 1/2 (gender) -> choose 1-4 (personality) -> washto (allocating 80 points across strength/comprehension/physique/agility, 13-30 each -- a different range than sibling xfbhh, by design). It ships its own custom client handshake ("self-connecting database") that shows a version check at login, though a plain telnet client works too once registration is typed as a single "account,password,cipher,email" line. Deep testing found and fixed a severe, previously-misdiagnosed bug: an unguarded restore() in the name-registry daemon threw on a corrupted save file, silently freezing every single new character's enter_world() forever with no error at all -- earlier native-mode testing had blamed this on a wizard-command search-path issue before the real cause was found. See NOTES.md.
